description: The 12 most recent Kibana browser sessions in the last 24 hours: length is how long, shade is how much was done. Click a bar to show that session’s records below. API-key work has no session. Ignores the time picker.

signals.name: lane
signals.update: length(data('sessions')) ? max(10, min(44, height / max(3, length(data('sessions'))))) : 12

on.update: {s: datum.start - 60000, e: datum.end + 60000, t: now(), n: 0}

!zoomTo ? null : zoomTo.n === 0 && now() - zoomTo.t > 700 ? (kibanaSetTimeFilter(zoomTo.s, zoomTo.e) ? null : {s: zoomTo.s, e: zoomTo.e, t: zoomTo.t, n: 1}) : zoomTo.n === 1 && now() - zoomTo.t > 1400 ? (kibanaSetTimeFilter(zoomTo.s, zoomTo.e) ? null : null) : zoomTo
datum.actor === 'no email recorded' ? null : kibanaAddFilter({match_phrase: {'user.email': datum.actor}}, 'logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default', 'actor: ' + datum.actor)

url.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?project == "" OR ?project == "Any") OR project.name == ?project) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND ENDS_WITH(?identity, " · Cloud API key") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND STARTS_WITH(?identity, "Unnamed key of ") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | WHERE kibana.session.id IS NOT NULL | WHERE event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time", "saved_object_close_point_in_time", "space_get", "space_find") OR (event.action == "http_request" AND (url.original IS NULL OR NOT url.original LIKE "*/api/*" OR url.original LIKE "*/api/ui_counters/*" OR url.original LIKE "*/api/content_management/*"))) | STATS events = COUNT(*), started = MIN(@timestamp), ended = MAX(@timestamp), nActions = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.action), actor = MIN(user.email), spaces = VALUES(kibana.space.id) BY key = kibana.session.id | SORT ended DESC, key | LIMIT 12 | EVAL start = TO_LONG(started), end = TO_LONG(ended) | DROP started, ended

transform.expr: datum.actor + ' · from ' + timeFormat(datum.start, timeFormat(datum.start, '%a') === timeFormat(now(), '%a') ? '%H:%M' : '%a %H:%M') + (datum.start < now() - 86400000 + 600000 ? ' or earlier' : '')

tooltip.signal: {'Identity': datum.actor, 'Session': slice(datum.key, 0, 12) + '…', 'Started': timeFormat(datum.start, '%a %d %b, %H:%M'), 'Ended': timeFormat(datum.end, '%a %d %b, %H:%M'), 'Duration': datum.minutes < 90 ? format(datum.minutes, '.0f') + ' min' : format(datum.minutes / 60, '.1f') + ' h', 'Events': format(datum.events, ','), 'Distinct actions': datum.nActions, 'Spaces': datum.spaceList, 'Click': 'filter to this session and zoom to it', 'Shift-click': 'pin this identity'}

text.value: No Kibana browser sessions for this selection in the last 24 hours — Elasticsearch API calls carry no session id.

text.signal: noSess ? 'latest activity with no session (API key or Elasticsearch API) · ' + timeFormat(noSess, '%H:%M') : ''
